name: crapto1
description: CRYPTO1 cipher and LFSR state-recovery math for MIFARE Classic (crapto1). GPLv2+ third-party source, Copyright (C) 2008-2014 bla <blapost@gmail.com>, vendored byte-identical from ~/src/unigeek-main/firmware/src/utils/crypto/. See src/crapto1.h's provenance header for the full citation trail, the canonical-upstream cross-check, and the one function (lfsr_recovery64) that diverges from upstream and must not be called.
_comment: MANIFEST FORMAT NOTE: this is a PlatformIO library.json, NOT the Arduino
library.properties that lib/MFRC522_I2C/ uses. That difference is
deliberate and was forced by a real build failure, not stylistic. A
library.properties manifest makes PlatformIO treat the library as
incompatible library .../lib/crapto1' and test/test_crapto1/ could not
even find crapto1.h. This library is plain C with no Arduino dependency
whatsoever and is genuinely host-testable, so it declares frameworks/
platforms '*' below and builds under both [env:tab5] and [env:native].
MFRC522_I2C keeps its upstream library.properties because it really is
Arduino-only (it includes Arduino.h and Wire.h) and is never built
